Grookey

Grass

Galar · Generation 8

Grookey is a Grass-type Chimp Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 5 kg. It evolves into Thwackey. Its highest base stat is Attack (65), with a base stat total of 310.
